# Getting Support | 获取帮助

Please use the right channel so we can help you quickly and keep the Issue tracker focused on actionable engineering work:

- **Questions, usage tips & feature ideas**: use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/helixnow/deep-student/discussions).
- **User documentation**: browse [`docs/user-guide/`](../docs/user-guide/) and [`docs/README.md`](../docs/README.md).
- **Bug reports**: open an issue using our [Bug Report form](https://github.com/helixnow/deep-student/issues/new/choose).
- **Security vulnerabilities**: **do not open a public issue** — report confidentially via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/helixnow/deep-student/security/advisories/new) (see [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)).
